case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: A rectangular outdoor planter for herbs or flowers, with at least 15 cm soil depth and drainage gaps around the base edges.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut a 60 cm base; keep the 59.7 cm offcut.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Cut 59 cm front and back; keep 1.4 cm offcut.
Place the narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two 16 cm ends; keep 87.4 cm offcut.
Place the 60 cm base flat on the floor.
Stand the front on the base front edge.
Stand the back on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between front and back.
Fit the right end between front and back.
Drill two pilot holes at the front-left corner.
Drive {count} screws at the front-left corner.
Drill two pilot holes at the front-right corner.
Drive {count} screws at the front-right corner.
Drill two pilot holes at the back-left corner.
Drive {count} screws at the back-left corner.
Drill two pilot holes at the back-right corner.
Drive {count} screws at the back-right corner.
Drill two pilot holes up through base into front.
Drive {count} screws up into the front.
Drill two pilot holes up through base into back.
Drive {count} screws up into the back.
Drill two pilot holes up through base into left end.
Drive {count} screws up into the left end.
Drill two pilot holes up through base into right end.
Drive {count} screws up into the right end.
Sand all cut edges smooth.
